proposals.title: Implement nominal types and scale constants in packages/core
proposals.why_now: The CanonicalEncoder is the only substantive code in core. ADR-003 (TRAVADO) precisely specifies Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as branded bigint types and Tick as a branded safe-integer number. No DEFINIR decision affects these definitions. Every other FASE-1 package — domain (ledger, entries), world (Price output), application (tick loop), contracts (DTOs) — is blocked at the type level until these exist. They are the shallowest dependency with the widest fan-out and have no external blockers.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 and implement deterministic positional RNG in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADO and requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR and prohibits the native language hash. This is an explicit DEFINIR listed in §19 lacunas conhecidas. INV-02 ('consultar price(asset,t) diretamente é igual a chegar em t avançando tick por tick') is described in the spec as the most important test of the project, and it depends entirely on the positional RNG being stateless and indexable. All six world namespaces (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, bot.decision) are blocked until rand() exists.

proposals.title: Write ADR-004 and implement bigint division helpers in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-004 is TRAVADO: every operation that loses precision must declare its rounding mode explicitly, and calling division without a mode is mandated to be a compile-time or lint-blocking error. The technical enforcement mechanism is an open DEFINIR. The domain ledger cannot implement spot execution, fee calculation, or rounding residue posting (INV-07) without these helpers. Leaving this unresolved allows implicit division to proliferate in domain stubs before the enforcement mechanism is in place.

proposals.title: Implement domain double-entry ledger in packages/domain
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 scope requires 'Ledger multi-commodity de dupla entrada' and 'Ordem a mercado, compra e venda spot'. INV-04 (per-commodity zero-sum in every Transaction), INV-05 (BRL sum always zero), and INV-06 (per-asset quantity sum always zero) are all FASE-1 acceptance gates. The ledger is the foundation for every domain operation — spot buy, sell, fee posting, rounding residue — and must precede the tick loop and the StateHash. Once core nominal types and division helpers exist, no DEFINIR blocks ledger implementation.

proposals.title: Implement world price generator (two assets, two noise layers) in packages/world
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires 'gerador de preço com duas camadas de ruído e dois ativos'. This is the primary consumer of the positional RNG and the entry point to INV-02 (direct tick query equals sequential advance), which is explicitly described as the most important test in the project. Two open DEFINIR decisions must be resolved as part of this task: octave parameters and block periods in a versioned config file (§5.1), and the fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for log-space price construction (transcendental Math functions are banned by §13 and ADR-003 in all pure packages). These ADRs must be written before the implementation merges.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo infrastructure is complete: CI pipeline, ESLint purity rules, dependency boundary checker, workspace config, and all package stubs exist. packages/core exports CanonicalEncoder (ADR-009 accepted, 101 tests passing). One ADR is on file (0009-canonical-encoding.md). Every other package — world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui, and all apps/desktop sub-packages — is an empty stub exporting nothing. No nominal types, no positional RNG, no ledger, no price generator, no tick loop, no save system, no CLI replay tool, no benchmark tool, no minimal UI, no installer exists anywhere in the repository.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core is missing the three foundational primitives that every downstream FASE-1 package depends on: (1) branded arithmetic types Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick specified in ADR-003; (2) deterministic positional RNG rand() required by ADR-002 and the world price generator; (3) bigint division helpers with explicit rounding modes required by ADR-004 and the domain ledger. Without these, domain, world, and application all remain unimplementable at the type level.

Three DEFINIR decisions remain simultaneously unresolved: (a) hash function algorithm for ADR-002 (positional RNG), (b) technical enforcement mechanism for division rounding mode (ADR-004), and (c) fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for log-space price construction plus octave parameters (§5.1). Each blocks a distinct FASE-1 delivery chain. They should be resolved in parallel, not sequentially, to avoid compressing the critical path.

FASE-1 acceptance requires a minimal installer for Windows and Linux ('instalador mínimo existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim', §14.6 TRAVADO). No work on Electron setup, preload, renderer, or electron-builder packaging has been started. The spec warns explicitly that deferring this risks ABI failures and native module rebuild issues in the final week. This risk accumulates every cycle this work is postponed.
